summary: SHOP-FOR department filter PASSES end-to-end. Backend unit tests 8/8 (tests/test_department_filter.py) + live E2E 11/11 (tests/test_shop_for_e2e.py) green against https://style-scan-v3.preview.emergentagent.com. (1) PUT /api/profile persists preferences.shop_for; the subsequent GET /api/catalogue/recommendations is HARD-filtered by department BEFORE scoring. shop_for=mens returned all 10 genuine men's IDs: ['211659','118360','116219','116327','181810','116218','230084','181797','113679','157060'] with ZERO Figl women's leak. shop_for=womens returned only Figl women's {111506,135767,150432} and NO men's IDs (Note: Figl 8411 is legitimately excluded by the already-persisted analysed palette's avoid-colour filter — ranking signals still operate AFTER the hard department filter, which is the intended behaviour). shop_for=all returns both departments. (2) GENUINE UNISEX unit test (test_genuine_unisex_allowed_for_either_preference) PASSES — a /UNISEX/ product shows under both mens and womens. (3) PRICING: product 113679 (Pierre Cardin, supplier 8.90) returned price==11.13 (8.90×1.25 HALF_UP) under shop_for=mens; product 111506 returned 16.13 under shop_for=womens — both asserted with ==. (4) NO METADATA LEAK: department, provider_id, provider_kind, source_url, availability, supplier_cost, wholesale_cost, customer_price are ALL absent from every item in the customer recommendations payload (verified across the live mens list). (5) FIELD COMPLETENESS: every men's item exposes product_id, name, brand, image_url, colour_names, sizes, materials, price and non-empty recommendation_reasons. (6) RANKING STILL OPERATES: setting budget_max=15 under shop_for=all keeps every returned item at price<=15 — proving budget still filters after the department hard filter. recommendation_reasons continue to reference colour/palette/climate/style axes. (7) TRY-ON HANDOFF (men's): POST /api/catalogue/products/113679/prepare-tryon returns a stored path + name, response contains NO preview_url and NO 'matterhorn' substring (prior Try-On leak-fix still intact). (8) ONE men's try-on generated end-to-end — POST /api/upload (person) + POST /api/tryon with person_image_path + garment_image_path (113679) returned a result_path and GET /api/tryons lists it. (9) PRIOR REGRESSION: PUT /api/profile with 'red' in both preferred_colours and avoided_colours returns HTTP 400 and does NOT persist the conflict. FRONTEND (390x844 mobile viewport): the Profile/You screen renders 'Shop for' section with chips Men | Women | All; tapping Men and reloading persists preferences.shop_for='mens' in GET /api/profile; the Discover screen then renders a men's product (Pierre Cardin visible in DOM, no 'Figl' substring anywhere). No red screens, no console errors. Profile has been reset to shop_for='all' at the end. One pre-existing non-blocking cosmetic: 'matterhorn-wholesale.com' still appears in rendered Discover DOM via product image_url hosts (same observation as iteration_3; image_url is NOT in the task's forbidden-keys list, left as-is).

issues: No testID on the 'Shop for' chips (Men/Women/All) or on the Save button — the Playwright run had to rely on get_by_text, and get_by_role('button', name='Save') timed out (persistence was confirmed only via backend GET /api/profile). Suggest testID='shop-for-men|women|all' and testID='profile-save' for stable automated regression.

Product image_url still points at matterhorn-wholesale.com CDN hosts, so the supplier domain is observable in the rendered DOM. The task's leak list is department/provider_id/provider_kind/source_url/availability (all correctly absent) — image_url is not forbidden, so this is NOT a regression, but if end-to-end supplier anonymity is desired, proxy images through /api/files or a signed route.

action_items: (Optional, cosmetic) Add testID attributes to the Shop-for chips (shop-for-men|women|all) and the profile Save button for stable future UI regression tests.
(Optional) If supplier anonymity is a product requirement, proxy product image_url through an app-owned route so matterhorn-wholesale.com never surfaces in the rendered DOM.

(Informational, not a bug) Under shop_for=womens the live default profile returns 3 of 4 Figl products because the persisted analysed palette avoids one colour on 8411 — this is correct 'ranking still operates after filter' behaviour; the unit test asserts all 4 only on a fresh/no-skin profile (verified).
critical_code_review_comments: derive_department correctly disambiguates WOMEN`S COATS vs MEN/... (unit test test_department_derived_from_genuine_category_path passes) — the apostrophe/possessive edge case is handled.
rank_verified_products applies the department filter via a hard exclusion BEFORE scoring (not merely a weight), so a department mismatch can never surface via tie-breaking.
customer_recommendations projection remains an allow-list (iteration_3 observation holds) — new internal fields on raw products cannot accidentally leak.
Pricing idempotency: markup is gated on customer_price being None, so re-ranking after persistence cannot double-apply the 1.25x factor.
profile.tsx reads/writes preferences.shop_for via PUT /api/profile and reflects the server echo on reload — persistence confirmed via live GET after chip tap.
prepare_catalogue_tryon response for product 113679 does not include preview_url and contains no 'matterhorn' substring — the earlier Try-On handoff leak fix is intact.
